description: CRIT-004 can pass at exactly 19/19 even though the literal fixture omits required failure/schema cases from REQ-011 and the verification architecture, including missing-table, period-resolution, source-limit, malformed-UI, and concurrent-snapshot cases. The independent oracle replays only the same underspecified fixture, so the threshold is not aligned with the required fixed matrix.

evidence.snippet: The criterion claims every required failure case is covered, but its threshold accepts the current 19 literal cases; behavioral-spec.md:130 and verification-architecture.md:76-77 require failure/schema and snapshot cases absent from score-semantics-cases.json.

resolution.notes: Expanded the executable matrix to 27/27 with six explicit failure/UI/snapshot contract cases plus unknown-kind and MENTAL timestamp cases; actual two-session PostgreSQL snapshot remains required by CRIT-003.
